Ola Electric auditor flags Rs 57 crore PLI penalty reversal

Ola Electric's auditor has flagged a reversal of a Rs 57 crore penalty related to the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme in the company's first-quarter results. This reversal has reportedly made investors jittery. The specific details of the penalty and its reversal were highlighted by the auditor in their report on the company's financial performance.
